en: Vintage Russian postal card with printed heading and imperial coat of arms on the left, addressed in cursive script. A red Imperial Russian postage stamp is affixed in the upper right corner with circular date and place cancellations overlapping it and the center of the card. The text is entirely in pre‑revolutionary Russian orthography and laid out in lines for the recipient's address.
